name: fetch-requests-in-hooks-need-timeouts
hook: Fetch hooks without timeouts can hang forever
body:
Any useEffect hook that makes a fetch request can hang indefinitely if the server doesn't respond. This causes isLoading to stay true forever. Fix: Use AbortController with a setTimeout to abort the request after a reasonable timeout (e.g., 15s). This is already documented in memory but the useCurrentUser hook was missing it.

**Why:** Bug #2579 manifested as the /admin/chat page showing 'Loading...' forever because useCurrentUser's fetch to /api/users/me had no timeout.
